segments.name: Cardiovascular medicines
segments.description: Develops and commercializes innovative cardiovascular medicines, centered on the self-administered etripamil nasal spray for PSVT patients.
segments.evidence: The Company manages its operations as a single operating segment for the purpose of assessing performance and making operating decisions while focusing on the development and commercialization of innovative cardiovascular medicines.

revenueModel.text: The company earns product revenue from sales of CARDAMYST distributed through wholesalers to retail pharmacies upon prescriptions, and may receive payments under licensing and collaboration arrangements.
revenueModel.evidence: which is then distributed via a third party logistics provider to wholesalers for delivery to retail pharmacies once prescriptions are received.
